name: How do different appliance types impact the preparation requirements for my kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do different appliance types impact the preparation requirements for my kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Different appliance types, such as a professional-grade range versus a standard stove, or a built-in refrigerator versus a freestanding one, have varied preparation requirements. Professional ranges might need enhanced ventilation and higher amperage electrical circuits, while built-in appliances demand precise cabinetry dimensions and specific utility access points. Frasheski Construction's team considers these specific needs during the planning phase of your kitchen renovation to ensure the area is perfectly tailored for your chosen appliances, especially in custom homes in Sausalito or Tiburon.
acceptedAnswer.description: Appliance types dictate preparation, with professional ranges needing enhanced utilities and built-ins requiring precise cabinetry, which Frasheski Construction integrates into renovation plans.
